items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: Hans Rosbog was the symphony conductor and he didn't treat him that well either. We used to eavesdrop on the rehearsals... Rosbog walked down and presents the stick and said, would you like to. I said no, no.

ctx.x: He hated conductor, he hated all the pretentions of conductors.
Hans Rosbog was the symphony conductor and he didn't treat him that well either.

We used to eavesdrop on the rehearsals; a wonderful conductor, that guy. I don't know what the exchange had been, but Rosbog walked down and presents the stick and said, would you like to. I said no, no. He said it was important to do it such a way.
